paper.title: PhysMem: Scaling Test-Time Memory for Embodied Physical Reasoning
paper.central_claim: PhysMem lets frozen VLM robot planners learn task-specific physical principles from interaction at test time without parameter updates: experiences are clustered into typed hypotheses, verified through interaction, and promoted to principles that condition later decisions; verification before application (principled abstraction) is claimed to beat direct experience retrieval (76% vs 23% on medium brick insertion, +23 over no memory) and to give consistent improvement over 30-minute real-world sessions and under changed physical conditions.

signatures.object: 冻结 VLM 规划器(Gemini-3-Flash thinking)之外的三层记忆库：episodic(≤3000 条经验)→working(待验证假设+置信度)→long-term(已验证 principle，衰减 γ=0.995)；基线=无记忆/直接检索/MemER-style/MemoryVLA-style/Reflexion-style
signatures.information: 规划器每步见观测、任务描述、至多 5 条 principle 与活动假设(带置信度)；反思模型(真机 Qwen3-VL，仿真 LLM)见同簇 3–5 条经验+已有知识；经验含 symbolic_state 离散特征；执行器固定(离散选项→运动规划)；反馈=环境结果 r∈{0,1}及步级分数(真机另有 SAM 碰撞检查拒绝不安全计划)；VLM 参数不更新。
signatures.operation: 记录经验并计算 resonance ρ；ρ<1(“惊讶”)触发 consolidation；按符号状态层次聚类(τ=0.6,n_min=2)→反思模型生成 Avoid/Prefer/Sequence 假设；按动作类型的成功率更新 conf(action-level attribution)；conf≥0.8 且支持≥3 晋升为 principle 并折叠源经验，conf≤0.3 且反例≥2 驳斥
signatures.output: 带置信度的类型化自然语言 principle/hypothesis，注入后续规划 prompt
signatures.conditions: 任务/情境在 episode 间部分重复；需环境重置；规划器须足够强以起草并运用假设(增益随底座 +5→+23)；符号状态可聚类
signatures.feedback: 每步 outcome 与步级分数；resonance
signatures.selection_rule: 阈值式晋升/驳斥(τ_p=0.8,τ_r=0.3，准确率≥85%)
signatures.selection_data: 同一部署流中的后续经验，无独立验证集；sim 阈值敏感性在评测条件上做
signatures.persistence: long-term 记忆，重要度衰减(约138 episode 半衰)；episodic 容量 3000，折叠后 TTL=100 episode 清理
signatures.later_use: 符号过滤+语义排序取 top-k 注入后续 prompt；低 resonance 时优先新学习
signatures.claimed_effect: brick insertion medium 53%→76%(vs Direct Retrieval 23%、Reflexion-style 61%)；真机三任务随会话改善；OOD 新球 10%→40%
signatures.failure_boundary: 过度泛化40%/延迟纠正35%/规划器忽略原则25%(medium 失败 24/100)；新球动力学下先验无效；连续动力学/文本表示受限；真机需人工重置

gap.author_gap: Frozen VLM planners hold declarative physics but cannot predict object-specific contact outcomes; retrieval/reflection memories apply past experience without checking it still holds, so stale memory hardens into wrong rules.
gap.checked_gap: Supported in-paper on the brick benchmark against author proxies (Direct Retrieval 23% < No Memory 53%; MemER-style 53%; Reflexion-style 61%). The sim task is dependency ordering rather than friction/dynamics; 'targeted interaction' is passive outcome statistics.

gap.residue: Apply experience safely under changed context by admitting/refuting rules rather than replaying raw episodes.
gap.stakes: Repeated physical errors under drift (e.g., ball stuck on obstacle), human resets in real deployment.
gap.method_response: Typed hypotheses + action-level confidence + promote/refute gates + resonance filtering + decay/folding.
gap.remaining_gap: Active (designed) verification, privilege-free symbolic state in simulation, continuous dynamics, autonomous reset, statistical strength of real-world results.

claims.text: 完整 PhysMem 在 brick insertion 上 89/76/39%(easy/med/hard)，高于无记忆 83/53/28、Direct Retrieval 48/23/8、Reflexion-style 86/61/31。

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Sim success is environment truth and real tasks report trial counts. Not transfer: OOD variants are same robot, lab and task families; the task prompts (naming conventions, friction ranking, decision rules) that define the harness are elided and cover the OOD materials (agg:A09), so EVIDENCE rule 2 non-use cannot be verified; prior-only OOD results are n=10 and show no transfer for balls; xArm6 and Franka-sim are both arm manipulation with memory re-learned per task.
assessment.author_claim_kept: Verified test-time memory lets a frozen VLM planner learn physical principles; verification before application beats direct retrieval (76% vs 23%) and helps under changed conditions.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With a frozen Gemini-3-Flash planner and fixed executor on Reflect-VLM brick insertion, the full memory bundle reports 89/76/39% vs 83/53/28% (no memory) and 86/61/31% (Reflexion-style proxy), and leave-one-out removal of verification or resonance costs 12-18 points on medium, within a pipeline whose symbolic state includes simulator-derived blocker features. Real-world tasks show directional improvement over no memory on small samples with an irreconcilable Parts score scale; prior-only OOD memory helps stacking (8/10 vs 4/10, n=10).
cannot_conclude: That the VLM discovered dependency structure from vision in simulation.
That hypotheses are verified before they influence decisions (active hypotheses are injected).
Transfer-level generalization or physics learning in the sim benchmark.

G.reason: Both seats 3; confirmed. Concrete residual bottleneck with in-paper quantification: unverified retrieval falls below no memory (23% vs 53% medium; 8% vs 28% hard) and free-form reflection plateaus (61%). Nearest neighbours (Reflexion, RAG/MAP-VLA, MemER, MemoryVLA) are named and placed in Table I, but tested only as training-free proxies; LLM-agent insight-extraction memories are not discussed. Not 4 because the frontier comparison is proxy-based and the 'targeted interaction' half of the gap is not actually addressed (verification is passive statistics).

M.reason: Both seats 3; confirmed. Typed hypothesis lifecycle (resonance-triggered consolidation, action-level confidence, promote/refute thresholds, folding, decay) responds to the stale-memory problem and yields distinguishable predictions that were tested (retrieval degrades with difficulty, verification/resonance matter more on harder tasks). Weaknesses that keep it below 4: 'verification before application' is not what the loop does (active hypotheses are injected into the planner before promotion, sol:E018); 'targeted interaction' is passive accumulation of naturally occurring outcomes (son55:E003); action-level attribution is confounded by clustering on co-occurring features (App. A-G examples); in simulation the promoted rule conditions on a simulator-derived blocker variable (agg:A04).

X.reason: Revised (sol unknown, son55 3). The memory operation chain is reconstructable with numeric thresholds (tau_p=0.8, tau_r=0.3, support>=3, contradictions>=2, capacity 3000, decay 0.995, top-5 injection), so this is not an unjudgeable unknown. But the information boundary and interface are not reconstructable: per-task prompt instances incl. 'Strategic Guidance: planning heuristics and decision rules' are author-elided in v6 (sol:E013, sol:E014, son55:E015); the provenance of simulator symbolic features is not stated and is inferred privileged (agg:A04); consistent(e,p) is undefined; hyperparameters conflict (consolidation every 50 episodes vs every 15 s; clustering threshold 0.6 vs 0.7; 5 vs 6 parts). This matches the X=2 anchor ('main steps described; interface/key conditions unclear'). Elision is an author choice in the reviewed version and is scored as missing reconstructability, not as missing material.
search_scope: Full v6 text L1-L54 incl. App. A-I re-read by aggregate for prompt contents, symbolic-feature provenance and hyperparameters.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2 (controller diff was a key-structure artifact). Simulation success is environment truth (env.is_success, 5 mm / quaternion tolerance). Real-world evidence uses author-defined plan-quality scores whose Parts scale (-1 -> 9.7) cannot be reconciled with the 0-5 definition, and resonance is a self-consistency proxy. The sim task measures ordering/blocking, not friction or dynamics, so it does not directly measure the 'physical principles' claim.

E.causality.reason: son55 value adopted (sol unknown). Relevant controls exist with the backbone and executor fixed: five memory paradigms (Table II), full leave-one-out ablations (Table VI: w/o verification -12, w/o resonance -18 on medium), four planner backbones, a 64-config threshold grid. The leave-one-out rows and the Direct Retrieval comparison share the symbolic-state channel (agg:A07, agg:A08), so 'verification/abstraction matter given this pipeline' is supported at the 2 level. Key controls missing: (1) the sim symbolic state includes simulator-derived blocker/dependency features (agg:A04) absent from the No-Memory arm, so part of the +23 over no memory may be privileged information rather than VLM discovery; no blocker-free ablation; (2) unequal tokens vs No Memory (2.5x), no equal-budget no-memory control; (3) baselines are author proxies; (4) prompt parity in real-world tasks cannot be verified because task prompts are elided. The provenance question is resolved by inference from fixed text, so it lowers the confidence of the headline contrast but does not make the item unjudgeable.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2. One explicit holdout (memory snapshots evaluated on 50 held-out episodes) plus frozen prior-only OOD rows; main tables are online streams in which memory is built and evaluated together, thresholds were tuned on the medium evaluation condition, no contamination or development-overlap statement, OOD is same robot/lab/task family.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 2. Denominators are clear (100 episodes/cell, 24/100 medium failures categorized, 87/281 refuted hypotheses, 64-config grid) and real learning curves have SD bands over 3 runs, but no variance/CI/paired test for any sim table although App. E-D says SD across 3 seeds is computed; several highlighted differences (hard 39 vs 31; +/-2 forgetting/folding) are within noise; OOD cells are n=10.

E.cost.reason: son55 value adopted (sol 2). Every paradigm and ablation row reports relative tokens, and those token figures include consolidation calls (agg:A05) - correcting son55's statement that reflection-model cost is excluded. Higher-token memory baselines (Reflexion-style 1.2x, MemoryVLA-style 2.5x) score lower than PhysMem at 1.0x (agg:A06), which partially tests the 'more tokens' alternative; per-step retrieval latency (+180 ms), background consolidation (1.4 s/cycle) and ~8% wall-clock overhead are reported. Not 4: no absolute tokens/USD, no equal-budget no-memory arm, real-world cost only asserted to 'track the same range'.
